core.title: Bighorn Single Cylinder Handleset with Carnaby Knob, Baldwin 180BNHXCYK

text.description_html:
Bighorn Single Cylinder Handleset with Carnaby Knob, Baldwin 180BNHXCYK

Bighorn makes a definitive design statement by balancing bold proportions with elegant symmetry. This handleset makes the perfect addition to more traditional style homes. The Venetian Bronze finish is hand-rubbed to reveal unique bronze highlights and provides a rich and warm complement to the handleset's style. It will fit 1-3/8 inch or 1-3/4 inch door thicknesses and with backsets of 2-1/2 inches or 2-3/4 inches.

Features of the Bighorn Handleset with Carnaby Knob:

  • Made of solid forged brass.
  • Elegant low profile cylinder
  • ANSI/BHMA Grade 2 security features
  • SmartKey re-key technology
  • Patented side locking bar technology offers improved security by protecting against lock bumping
  • Comes packaged with two keys.
  • Lifetime Limited Warranty on workmanship, materials and operation.

Specifications of the Bighorn Handleset with Carnaby Knob:

  • Outside Plate Length: 18.5"
  • Outside Plate Width: 2.8"
  • Projection of Outside Handle: 3.2"
  • Inside Plate Length: 3.3"
  • Inside Plate Width: 2.6"
  • Knob Diameter (interior): 1.9"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" or 1-3/8"
  • Backset: adjustable 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Finish: Venetian Bronze

The finish for the inside knob or lever you choose will match the outside finish.
